faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
faqs.answer: Yes, walk-ins are welcome on a first-come basis. Appointments are given priority, so booking ahead helps you avoid waiting. Sunday visits are by appointment only.

faqs.question: What should I bring for my first visit?
faqs.answer: Please bring a photo ID, any previous dental reports or X-rays, and a list of the medicines you currently take.

faqs.question: Is root canal treatment painful?
faqs.answer: Root canal treatment is done under local anaesthesia, so most patients feel little or no pain during the procedure. Some mild soreness afterwards is common, and the dentist will explain the aftercare to you.

faqs.question: How long do teeth whitening results last, and is it safe?
faqs.answer: Whitening results usually last 6 to 12 months, depending on habits such as tea, coffee and smoking. Professional whitening is done under the dentist's supervision after a check-up, to make sure it is suitable for you.

faqs.question: Do you offer EMI or instalment plans?
faqs.answer: For larger treatments such as braces, aligners and implants, instalment plans can be discussed at your consultation. Please ask our reception team for details.

faqs.question: How do you keep your instruments sterile?
faqs.answer: All reusable instruments are cleaned and sterilised in an autoclave after every patient. We use fresh disposable gloves, masks and suction tips for each visit.

faqs.question: From what age can I bring my child to the dentist?
faqs.answer: We recommend a first dental visit around your child's first birthday, or when the first tooth appears. Our paediatric dentist sees children on selected days, so please ask us for the schedule.

faqs.question: Are dental X-rays safe?
faqs.answer: Dental X-rays use a very low dose of radiation, and we use a protective lead apron. We only take an X-ray when the dentist feels it is necessary.

faqs.question: Can I get copies of my X-rays and treatment records?
faqs.answer: Yes, digital copies of your X-rays and treatment records can be shared with you on WhatsApp or email on request.

faqs.question: How long does a typical appointment take?
keywords: how much time will it take
how long will i be there
faqs.answer: A check-up usually takes 20 to 30 minutes. Treatment visits typically take 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the procedure.

faqs.question: Do your doctors speak Hindi or Marathi?
faqs.answer: Yes, our team speaks English, Hindi and Marathi.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book?
keywords: how soon can i get an appointment
faqs.answer: For check-ups and cleaning, booking 1 to 2 days ahead is usually enough. For braces, aligners, implants and other planned treatments, please book about a week ahead.

faqs.question: Do you send appointment reminders?
faqs.answer: Yes, our reception team sends a WhatsApp reminder the day before your appointment. Please reply to confirm, or tell us if you need to reschedule.
